purpose: Profile whether exact equivalent task-local oracle work is material in unchanged Master-Oracle before implementing a narrowly scoped reuse wrapper.

in_scope: read-only import and wrapper instrumentation around pinned ess-advisor APIs
the original task-wise signed maximal-matching PESS objective
independent exact Fraction verification of tiny references and feasible objectives
a treatment only if the profiler demonstrates a material exact-equivalence opportunity
out_of_scope: any source change in ess-advisor or ess-postgresql
any change to Stage 0 or Stage 1 experiment trees
a shared global-policy worst case or priority-order decision variable
PostgreSQL or physical ANALYZE performance claims
publication-novelty claims based on routine memoization

model.objective: minimize the sum over tasks of weights times the maximum positive pre-clamp absolute signed affine log loss over inclusion-wise maximal labeled matchings of each selected task graph
model.selection: unordered labeled global resource set M
model.inner_family: MaximalMatchings(H_i[M]); empty matching is maximal when no selected task edge exists
model.coefficients: mixed-sign alpha and b are permitted; parallel labels and zero-cost resources are retained
model.maintenance: the instance-provided additive proxy only; generic Maint(M) remains abstract and nonadditive
model.reference: independent Fraction arithmetic, distinct from floating-point MILP solver-reported status

baseline_configuration.solver_threads: one process per run; no simultaneous final solver processes
baseline_configuration.randomness: fixed input bytes, fixed repetition seeds, and deterministic block order

runtime.highs: SciPy-bundled HiGHS; standalone version is not exposed by the SciPy Python API
runtime.platform: record exact platform.uname(), BLAS/OpenMP variables, CPU model, and process limits in every executed run

source_and_runtime_pin.configuration_evidence: These are the Stage 1B pinned public dependencies and adapter settings; execution must record observed versions rather than infer them from this text.

original_stage1b.copy_policy: copy bytes into this experiment's frozen inputs in a later input-only commit; do not edit the Stage 1B originals

independent.generation: deterministic standard-library random.Random with explicit seed; generator and generated bytes are committed together before profiling
postgeneration_checks: valid instance schema accepted by read_instance
all task-local eligible edges are labeled and preserve parallel identities
each nonempty selected task graph has a finite inclusion-wise maximal matching family
at least one signed-cancellation task and one zero-cost resource occur in the declared controls
SHA256SUMS is generated before profiling and never amended to remove a case

controls.easy: tiny path/star instances with few task-local configurations
controls.hard: large_cycle_3922, large_sharing_cycle_3924, large_mixed_parallel_3923, and independent medium shared/conflicting-cycle cases
controls.unfavorable: cases whose task-local graph or master point changes every oracle request; no reuse is expected and these rows remain in the analysis

profiler_gate.instrumentation: research-side import/wrapper only; no advisor mutation and no GitHub/API source writes
record_each_task_oracle_call: full canonical input identity or a collision-resistant digest plus serialized key components
alpha and every eligible signed coefficient
fractional master point and all claimed clauses/cuts affecting admissibility
tolerances, time limit, solver options, objective/witness meaning, and relevant solver-state identity
oracle/witness/cut state read or changed, duration, outcome, and exception/timeout

canonical_equivalence_key.definition: A tuple of canonical serialized values: task id; sorted labeled selected task-edge records (resource label, ordered endpoints, task membership); alpha; sorted eligible labeled edge records with exact signed Fraction coefficients; fractional master vector for every global resource; claimed-cut/admissibility clauses; solver tolerances and time limits; all options affecting objective or witness semantics; and a versioned oracle implementation/configuration token.
canonical_equivalence_key.key_rule: Two calls may share a result or reusable substate only when every tuple component is byte-identical after canonical serialization. A digest is an index, never the semantic proof of equality; collisions are checked by comparing the serialized tuple.
canonical_equivalence_key.invalidation: Invalidate on any selected-resource, endpoint, label, coefficient, alpha, master-point, claimed-clause, tolerance, objective/witness, solver-option, implementation-version, or admissibility change. Cache lifetime and memory are per one top-level solve unless a later protocol explicitly authorizes otherwise.

opportunity_metrics: wall time and count of exact-equivalent repeated calls
cacheable proportion by time and by call count
duplicate full-key count and collision/near-collision diagnostics
oracle/witness/cut-state reuse candidates and invalidation reasons
baseline solver adapter time and end-to-end time including independent verification

stop_rules.no_op_stop: If exact-equivalent repeated calls account for less than 10 percent of measured task-oracle wall time on every frozen hard case, issue NO-GO and do not implement or benchmark a treatment.
stop_rules.access_stop: If a sound full-key profile cannot be obtained through the permitted read-only adapter without changing ess-advisor, issue BLOCKED and stop.
stop_rules.correctness_stop: If the exact reuse invariant, independent Fraction verifier, or witness/maximality checks cannot be completed, issue BLOCKED and do not make speed claims.
stop_rules.resource_stop: If the preregistered profiling caps or exclusive CPU window cannot be enforced and recorded, issue INCONCLUSIVE rather than silently changing the design.
stop_rules.scope_stop: Do not substitute a different heuristic, partial key, shared global policy, or source modification for a stopped treatment.

phase_plan.phase_0: commit this protocol and manifest plan
phase_plan.phase_1: commit copied original inputs, generated independent inputs, generator, hashes, and schema/freeze checks only
phase_plan.phase_2: run read-only baseline profiler; write immutable JSONL and diagnostics; apply stop rules
phase_plan.phase_3: only after Gate A and Gate B pass, implement a wrapper treatment under this directory and matched benchmark
phase_plan.memory_cap: must be enforced by a recorded cgroup/ulimit or marked NOT ENFORCED
phase_plan.randomization: deterministic randomized blocks; no dropping timeout, invalid, or unfavorable rows

decision_categories.go: Only a separate algorithm-development issue may be proposed if exact equivalence is material, correctness is independently established, treatment beats unchanged Static and unchanged Master on preregistered hard strata without regression, and a targeted prior-art audit identifies a genuine unresolved research distinction.
decision_categories.no_go: Duplicate work is immaterial, key is unsafe, treatment loses to Static, memory/startup overhead dominates, negative controls fail, or the method is routine/uncompetitive.
decision_categories.inconclusive_blocked: Required hook, exact reference, resource control, or frozen coverage is missing. No speculative replacement search is permitted.

evidence_labels.model_math: Proven (model-internal) only when assumptions and proof are recorded
evidence_labels.source: Source-derived (conditional) for the pinned advisor source and API behavior
evidence_labels.measurements: Experimentally observed only with environment, version, inputs, seeds, commands, raw JSONL, and hashes
evidence_labels.solver: Floating-point solver-reported status/bounds, not an independent exact global certificate
evidence_labels.hypothesis: Conjecture/Open until the preregistered profiler and checks run
